newsitem.title: FRANCE: First French wheat bid covers 40,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: First French wheat bid covers 40,000 tonnes.

text.p: The first tier of European Union grain export bids placed through France on Thursday, for a rebate of 7.49 Ecus per tonne, covers 40,000 tonnes out of the total 725,550 tonnes sought, traders said.
This subsidy level values French wheat at around $166 per tonne, they said.
Following is a cumulative breakdown of the soft wheat bids at the weekly EU tender, estimated by traders.
Refunds are shown in Ecus per tonne.
French cereals office ONIC does not publish a breakdown. It said earlier that grain exporters bid through France for 725,550 tonnes of soft wheat at refunds of 7.49 to 17.44 Ecus per tonne.
